_comment: Deterministic mprr short-packet timing run for the ring-ingest gate + the viewer/store drivers. 100ns ticks (timingTicks64). Packets are block-aligned (interval 1_000_000 ticks = 100ms; blockDurationTicks 3_000_000 = 300ms) so the realized block-boundary variation is 0 pct => authoritative. bytes vary deterministically so cumulative-bytes is a non-trivial series.
